# Target.com

> Target is a leading U.S. retailer offering affordable everyday essentials, seasonal merchandise, and curated brands. Guests can shop in-store, online, via Drive Up, Order Pickup, Same Day Delivery, and fast shipping.

> Note: Target product pages follow the format /p/{product slug}/-/A-{TCIN}.

> Note: Target category pages follow the format /c/{category name}/-/N-{category node ID}.

> Note: Target browse pages follow the format /b/{browse name}/-/N-{browse node ID}.

## Core Shopping Categories
- [Toys](https://www.target.com/c/toys/-/N-5xtb0): Toys, games, puzzles, and outdoor play.
- [Electronics](https://www.target.com/c/electronics/-/N-5xtg6): TVs, phones, laptops, and accessories.
- [Baby](https://www.target.com/c/baby/-/N-5xtly): Baby gear, diapers, and clothing.
- [Grocery](https://www.target.com/c/grocery/-/N-5xt1a): Food, beverages, and household staples.
- [Clothing, Shoes & Accessories](https://www.target.com/c/clothing-shoes-accessories/-/N-rdihz): Apparel and footwear for the family.
- [Home](https://www.target.com/c/home/-/N-5xtvd): Find everything you need for your home at Target. Shop decor, bedding, bath, and more to create a space you'll love.
- [Furniture](https://www.target.com/c/furniture/-/N-5xtnr): Living room, bedroom, and office.
- [Beauty](https://www.target.com/c/beauty/-/N-55r1x): Skincare, cosmetics, and haircare.
- [Personal Care](https://www.target.com/c/personal-care/-/N-5xtzq): Everyday hygiene and self-care.
- [Health](https://www.target.com/c/health/-/N-5xu1n): Pharmacy, wellness, and medical supplies.
- [Household Essentials](https://www.target.com/c/household-essentials/-/N-5xsz1): Cleaning supplies, paper products, and storage.
- [Kitchen & Dining](https://www.target.com/c/kitchen-dining/-/N-hz89j): Cookware, dinnerware, and appliances.
- [Party Supplies](https://www.target.com/c/party-supplies/-/N-5xt3c): Party decor and tableware.
- [Sports & Outdoors](https://www.target.com/c/sports-outdoors/-/N-5xt85): Fitness, sporting goods, and outdoor gear.
- [Movies, Music & Books](https://www.target.com/c/movies-music-books/-/N-5xsxe): Entertainment media.
- [Arts, Crafts & Sewing](https://www.target.com/c/arts-crafts-sewing-home/-/N-5xt4g): Creative and hobby supplies.
- [Luggage](https://www.target.com/c/luggage/-/N-5xtz1): Suitcases, carry-ons, and travel bags.
- [School & Office Supplies](https://www.target.com/c/school-office-supplies/-/N-5xsxr): Stationery, backpacks, and planners.
- [Top Deals](https://www.target.com/c/top-deals/-/N-4xw74): Current promotions and savings.
- [Clearance](https://www.target.com/c/clearance/-/N-5q0ga): Discounted items across categories.
- [Shop All Categories](https://www.target.com/c/shop-all-categories/-/N-5xsxf): Explore all product categories.

## Services & Fulfillment
- [Drive Up](https://www.target.com/c/drive-up/-/N-9d42z): Curbside pickup service.
- [Order Pickup](https://www.target.com/c/order-pickup/-/N-ng0a0): Buy online, pick up in store.
- [Same Day Delivery](https://www.target.com/c/same-day-delivery/-/N-bswkz): Delivered to your door with Shipt.
- [Free 2-Day Shipping](https://www.target.com/c/free-2-day-shipping/-/N-49cz6): Fast, free shipping on eligible items.
- [Shipping & Order Services](https://www.target.com/c/shipping-order-services/-/N-551st): Overview of shipping, delivery, and pickup.
- [Services](https://www.target.com/c/services/-/N-oq1wk): Pharmacy, optical, photo, and more.
- [Target Circle](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle/-/N-pzno9): Free loyalty program.
- [Target Circle 360](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle-360/-/N-2rguk): Paid membership with enhanced benefits.
- [Target Circle Card](https://www.target.com/circlecard): RedCard program.
- [Gift Registry](https://www.target.com/gift-registry): Create or shop registries.
- [Returns](https://www.target.com/returns): Return options and policies.
- [Find Stores](https://www.target.com/store-locator/find-stores): Search Target store locations by city, state, or ZIP.

## Owned Brands (Phase 1)
- [Cat & Jack](https://www.target.com/b/cat-jack/-/N-qqqgm): Kids' clothing and school essentials.
- [A New Day](https://www.target.com/b/a-new-day/-/N-xrye7): Women's apparel and accessories.
- [Art Class](https://www.target.com/b/art-class/-/N-holui): Kids' and teens' apparel.
- [Universal Thread](https://www.target.com/b/universal-thread/-/N-1vs54): Women's denim and casual apparel.
- [Threshold](https://www.target.com/b/threshold/-/N-56dig): Furniture and home decor.
- [up&up](https://www.target.com/b/up/-/N-q643lepiiob): Household and everyday essentials.
- [Market Pantry](https://www.target.com/b/market-pantry/-/N-85ceg): Grocery staples.
- [Good & Gather](https://www.target.com/b/good-gather/-/N-yfqzk): Food and beverage brand.
- [Room Essentials](https://www.target.com/b/room-essentials/-/N-5y3a8): Affordable furniture and basics.
- [Everspring](https://www.target.com/b/everspring/-/N-gl7n0): Eco-friendly cleaning and household items.
- [Hyde & EEK! Boutique](https://www.target.com/b/hyde-and-eek-boutique/-/N-q643leo4u2a): Halloween decor, costumes, and seasonal items.
- [All in Motion](https://www.target.com/b/all-in-motion/-/N-q643lerbxbq): Activewear and fitness gear.

## Optional
- [Corporate Home](https://corporate.target.com/): Corporate site.
- [About Target](https://corporate.target.com/about): Company overview.
- [News & Features](https://corporate.target.com/news-features): Latest press releases and stories.
- [Target Brands](https://corporate.target.com/about/products-services/target-brands): Full owned brands portfolio.
- [Products & Services](https://corporate.target.com/about/products-services): Retail categories and guest services.
- [Investors](https://corporate.target.com/investors): Financial reports and stock information.

## Optional (Seasonal & Inspiration)
- [Holiday Shop](https://www.target.com/c/holiday-shop/-/N-4ydi5): Seasonal decor and gifts.
- [Halloween](https://www.target.com/c/halloween/-/N-5xt2o): Costumes, candy, and party supplies.
- [Gift Ideas](https://www.target.com/c/gift-ideas/-/N-96d2i): Curated gift collections for every occasion.
